    From biserial projectives to their element form #

    The left ideal A e_i is an indecomposable projective whose radical is R e_i (radical_Pe). A uniserial submodule of a finite-dimensional module is cyclic, generated by an element fixed by some e_s (exists_gen). Hence the biserial condition on left projectives gives BisAt i for every vertex (bisAt_of_biserial).
